candidate.name: Buka
candidate.note: Town: Buka, the most bustling town in Bougainville and the seat of government since the civil war, with the Buka Market, the Buka Passage boats and waterfront restaurants.

candidate.name: Lorengau
candidate.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage Lorengau geo tag (town centre; a town, not an attraction)
candidate.note: Town: capital of Manus Province on the edge of Seeadler Harbour, with a market, a garamut dance tradition, sago village visits and the Harbourside Hotel tours.

candidate.name: Malagan Carvings
candidate.note: Culture: the Malagan carving tradition of New Ireland, seen in carving workshops and collections and at Malagan ceremonies; a practice rather than one fixed place, so the judge may fold it into the carving villages.

candidate.name: Momote Memorial Park
candidate.note: Memorial park: WWII memorial park at Momote on Los Negros, named on the Seeadler Bay Hotel listing on the PNG tourism page as one of Lorengau's attractions.

candidate.name: Seeadler Harbour
candidate.note: Harbour: the Seeadler Harbour (Seeadler Bay) at Lorengau, a WWII US naval base harbour with the Seeadler Bay Hotel and Harbourside Hotel on its shore; a water body visited by boat.
